outcome: levels of sFlt-1, PIGF, 8-epi-PGF2α, TAC, 8-epi-PGF2α:PIGF ratio, PIGF:sFlt-1 ratio
cohort: 175 pregnant women categorized into three age groups: 20-29 years, 30-34 years, and 35-45 years (AMA)
finding: Advanced maternal age (AMA) was significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes and an imbalance in oxidative stress biomarkers and angiogenic growth mediators.
mod_finding: AMA was associated with higher rates of both emergency and elective caesarean sections.
